settings.title: Trip Overview
settings.body:
This is your private travel dashboard. Trip details and itinerary information will appear here.

Use this area later for trip summaries, destinations, dates, booking references, or customer-specific portal data.

settings.title: Booking Status
settings.body:
Placeholder for live booking progress, payment milestones, confirmation stages, or team updates.

This can later be powered by customer metafields, tags, or external sync logic.

settings.title: Upcoming Plans
settings.body: Add upcoming trip milestones here, such as travel dates, planning tasks, reminders, or pre-departure actions.

settings.title: Future Salesforce / Itinerary Integration
settings.body:
This reserved panel is intended for future Salesforce-connected trip data, itinerary feeds, documents, or support notes.

Keeping it in this section means the data source can change later without rebuilding the page structure.

settings.heading: Your Trip
settings.intro: This is your private travel dashboard. Trip details and itinerary information will appear here.
settings.member_note: Future enhancements can pull in customer metafields, customer tags, metaobject-based trip records, or app/API data without changing the page access rules.
settings.logged_out_title: Please log in to access your trip
settings.logged_out_message: You need to log in with your Shopify customer account to view your private trip dashboard.
